{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values for flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g (only these two are needed for correlation)
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute Pearson correlation for the entire dataset
overall_corr = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Compute correlation within each island
corr_by_island = penguins_clean.groupby('island').apply(
    lambda group: group['flipper_length_mm'].corr(group['body_mass_g'])
)

# Compute correlation within each species
corr_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species').apply(
    lambda group: group['flipper_length_mm'].corr(group['body_mass_g'])
)

# Print results
print(f'Overall correlation (all penguins): {overall_corr:.4f}')
print('\nCorrelation by island:')
print(corr_by_island)
print('\nCorrelation by species:')
print(corr_by_species)"}
